BPA-1103                                                                                                                   about:srcdoc  
  
  
  Exam Date & Time: 11-Dec-2023 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  FIFTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - NOVEMBER/DECEMBER 2023  
  Statistics and Data Analysis [BPA-1103]  
  Marks: 50                                                                                Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)              What is the central limit theorem? Define it.  
  (5)  
  
  2)              What is multicollinearity? Explain the cause and effect of it on the model. How  
  to detect its presence in the model? Write down its formula.                              (5)  
  
  3)              What is error term and residual? Why does it arise in the model? How can we minimize  
  it?                                                                                  (5)  
  
  4)              What is endogeneity and omitted variable bias in the regression model? What is the  
  reason for its presence and effect on the model?                                          (5)  
  
  5)              Write down the function of the Probit model. Explain the method by which the odds  
  ratio is calculated.                                                                      (10)  
  
  6)              Discuss the different sampling methods, including random, stratified, and convenience.  
  (10)  
  
  7)              What is the correlation between two variables X and Y? How it is different from  
  causation? Write down the formula for the correlation coefficient.                        (10)  
  
  
  -----End-----
